evidence: date: predict starts after train ends → time-based split
why_generic_validation_is_risky: Random k-fold or stratified k-fold will train on future data and validate on past data, producing optimistic scores that will not hold in production.

recommendation.reason: Prediction data comes strictly after training data — temporal ordering must be respected.
recommendation.fit_rule: Train on all data up to a cutoff date.
recommendation.validation_rule: Validate on data after the cutoff (simulating the prediction window).

alternatives.reason: Rolling window validation can better capture temporal model decay.
